requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: The Magellan printer must support NGB keyed bottles with 6,000-page yield for black and CMY inks. CMY bottle size must support yields greater than 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: High-yield bottles reduce refill frequency and support business/enterprise requirements for efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, ink compatibility, platform integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can accept and use NGB keyed bottles, achieving at least 6,000-page yield for black and CMY; CMY bottles must be sized for >8,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ink bottle and tank system must ensure spill-free reliability during refilling and maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents damage, improves user experience, and reduces warranty claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spills during refill or maintenance in >99% of tested scenarios.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: The NOA-F must include a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, with no changes to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances reliability and traceability; maintains compatibility with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units manufactured with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, compatible with click-on push-push and TDF.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA
requirements.Description: Magellan must reuse SuperAmp Si PHA technology in its platform.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages proven technology, reduces development cost and risk.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA integrated and functional in Magellan platform.

requirements.Title: Reuse Magi/Nessie Ink (No Reformulation)
requirements.Description: Magellan must use existing Magi and Nessie pigment inks without reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures ink reliability, reduces qualification time, and leverages existing supply chain.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printer accepts and prints with Magi/Nessie inks, with no reformulation required.

requirements.Title: Reliability, WVTR, Air Gain, Flow Rate and IDS Characterization
requirements.Description: Magellan must support reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, and IDS characterization and modeling, including startup and NOA-F EOL.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures robust performance and longevity; critical for warranty and service.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Documented models and test results for reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, and IDS, including startup and NOA-F EOL scenarios.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Perform ink stability modeling for tank and impact to print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality and reduces risk of ink degradation over time.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability model completed and validated for tank and PQ impact.

requirements.Title: NOA-F Service Parts in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as service parts for warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and improves customer satisfaction during warranty repairs.
requirements.Stakeholders: Service Teams, Warranty Support, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F parts available and replaceable under warranty conditions.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Acumen 6 must be applied to the lid for traceability and authentication.
requirements.Rationale: Improves product traceability and anti-counterfeit measures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 present and scannable on every lid produced.

requirements.Title: Modify SA14 Line for NOA-F
requirements.Description: Factory configuration must modify existing SA14 line to support NOA-F production.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures manufacturing capability for new NOA-F parts.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 line operational for NOA-F production.

requirements.Title: Add Magi Ink Cart and Labelling Tool in Orcus 5
requirements.Description: Orcus 5 factory must add Magi ink cartridge and labeling tool for production.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new ink and labeling requirements for Magellan.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magi ink cart and labeling tool installed and operational in Orcus 5.

requirements.Title: Assembly of PHA + Dry FI + USG + Push Push in Printer Factory
requirements.Description: Printer factory must assemble PHA, Dry FI, USG, and push-push components.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures complete assembly and integration of critical modules.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer factory produces units with all four components assembled.

requirements.Title: ISDO Capex for SA14 Line, Magi/Nessie Ink Cart and Label Tool, Mold for 1-4 New Keyed Caps
requirements.Description: Allocate ISDO Capex for SA14 line upgrades, Magi/Nessie ink cart and labeling tool in Orcus 5, and molds for 1-4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Enables production of new components and supports scale-up.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Capex allocated and upgrades completed for SA14, Orcus 5, and molds.

requirements.Title: Leverage Watt LE/Marconi Hi Mech + CISS
requirements.Description: Magellan must leverage existing Watt LE and Marconi Hi mechanical platforms, integrating CISS.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and cost, improves reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan platform integrates Watt LE/Marconi Hi mech and CISS successfully.

requirements.Title: Print Speed: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must achieve print speeds of 25/20 pages per minute (PDL: 25/19ppm).
requirements.Rationale: Meets market and business requirements for throughput.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, End Users, SMB, Enterprise
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified print speeds in standard test conditions.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Magellan must support customer replaceable PHA and NOA-F modules.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for end users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F modules without technical assistance.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Magellan must achieve a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product longevity and reduces warranty claims.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Service Teams, End Users
requirements.Dependencies: Component reliability, ink system, platform design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves 80,000-page life under warranty conditions.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS
requirements.Description: Magellan must offer SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) as Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS).
requirements.Rationale: Supports flexible business models and market segmentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 available as PaaS offering.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Tank Size Increase
requirements.Description: Magellan must use Reddington ID with increased tank size. No change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher yield and aligns with existing product identity.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printer uses Reddington ID and tank size is increased as specified.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Magellan must use EPS foam packaging for protection during shipping.
requirements.Rationale: Improves product safety and reduces damage during transit.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging used for all shipped units.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, Blue Angel Requirements for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Magellan must meet EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compliance with environmental and quality standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Input and output trays must be changed to align with tank protrusion.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures proper fit and function with increased tank size.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Input/output trays modified and functional with tank protrusion.

requirements.Title: Size Optimization
requirements.Description: Optimize printer size to accommodate new tank and component changes.
requirements.Rationale: Improves space efficiency and user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer size optimized for new tank and components without sacrificing functionality.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Magellan must include a 4.3” CGD display for user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances usability and supports advanced features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer includes and operates with 4.3” CGD display.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Tubes and Sayan Sibstar Tubes
requirements.Description: Magellan must leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes, with new routing and integration for 4-tube platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports CISS and ink flow requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer platform uses 4 tubes with Sayan Sibstar tubes and new routing.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Service station must manage aerosols with spit platform changes due to tank.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces contamination and ensures print quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station design, spit platform integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system implemented and functional in service station.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with Tube and New Weights
requirements.Description: Carriage must be dynamically modeled for force with tube integration and new component weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and optimal print performance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Dynamic force model completed and validated for carriage with tubes and new weights.

requirements.Title: Paperpath to Support Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Paperpath must be designed to support increased page life (80k).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliability and longevity for high-volume users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paperpath supports 80k page life without significant wear or failure.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Ink maintenance must be a serviceable part, replaceable at service centers after 80k page life.
requirements.Rationale: Supports extended product use and reduces maintenance costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance part design, service center process
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part is replaceable at service centers after 80k page life.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA, NOA-F, Keyed Bottles, Magi and Nessie Pigment Inks
requirements.Description: Magellan must support SuperAmp PHA, NOA-F, keyed bottles, Magi, and Nessie pigment inks.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compatibility with advanced ink and supply technologies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports and operates with all specified supplies.

requirements.Title: 140ml K Bottles and xx ml CMY Bottles
requirements.Description: Magellan must use 140ml black bottles and appropriately sized CMY bottles (exact size TBD).
requirements.Rationale: Supports high-yield requirements and efficient ink usage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer uses 140ml K bottles and specified CMY bottles.

requirements.Title: IDS New Make-break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: IDS must support new make-break and FI connection.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and serviceability of ink delivery system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS supports new make-break and FI connection in all units.

requirements.Title: Leverage LEBI Ink-tank with Increased Size, Keying, and LOI One SHAID
requirements.Description: Magellan must leverage LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Supports high-yield and secure ink delivery.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer uses LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: IDS must include new startup algorithm and air management for improved reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces startup failures and ensures consistent ink flow.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS startup algorithm and air management implemented and validated.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Magellan must implement new servicing and startup algorithms for improved reliability and user experience.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service calls and improves startup success rate.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New servicing and startup algorithms operational in all units.

requirements.Title: New PQ Goals & Depletion to Meet Page Yield Definition
requirements.Description: Magellan must set new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion rates to meet defined page yield.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent output and meets yield expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves PQ goals and depletion rates as defined for page yield.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Magellan must reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages proven hardware, reduces development cost and risk.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer uses and operates with specified hardware components.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-fi Module
requirements.Description: Magellan must integrate Stingray Wi-fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern connectivity requirements for end users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer connects wirelessly using Stingray Wi-fi module.

requirements.Title: FW Dune Integration
requirements.Description: Magellan must use FW Dune firmware platform.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compatibility and leverages existing firmware technology.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer operates with FW Dune firmware.

requirements.Title: Security: Gauss4.xx HW & FW
requirements.Description: Magellan must implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features.
requirements.Rationale: Protects against threats and ensures product integrity.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer meets Gauss4.xx security requirements.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence
requirements.Description: Magellan must adhere to defined schedule checkpoints for HW, NOA-F, and Bottle.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures timely delivery and aligns with business priorities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All checkpoints met on schedule as defined.

requirements.Title: Business Model: Consumer, SMB, Enterprise
requirements.Description: Magellan must support business models for consumer, SMB, and enterprise segments.
requirements.Rationale: Maximizes market reach and supports diverse customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan available and marketed to consumer, SMB, and enterprise segments.

requirements.Title: Service: PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker
requirements.Description: Magellan must support Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and WorkFromHome/Flexworker service models.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses new market trends and customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan supports PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker services.

requirements.Title: Onboarding/S&O Pathways
requirements.Description: Magellan must support onboarding and S&O pathways for Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP.
requirements.Rationale: Facilitates smooth onboarding and integration for all customer segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan onboarding supports all specified pathways.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution, SMB Manageability, Enterprise Support (WJA, HPSM, JAM)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support including WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures comprehensive functionality for all market segments.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, SMB, Enterprise, Service Teams
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan supports scan, SMB manageability, and enterprise support features.

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Magellan must support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compatibility with HP ecosystem and customer requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan supports all specified clients and drivers.

requirements.Title: Protect Micro/SMB Segments and HP’s Ink/Laser Profit Pool
requirements.Description: Magellan must protect micro/SMB segments and HP’s traditional ink/laser profit pool from competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains HP’s market share and profitability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market share and profit pool protected as measured by quarterly reports.

requirements.Title: Lead with LaserJet, Flank with PDL in Medium/Enterprise Segments
requirements.Description: Magellan must lead with LaserJet and flank with PDL in medium and enterprise segments to win over competitors as CISS grows.
requirements.Rationale: Strategic positioning to maximize market share and growth.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market share gains in medium/enterprise segments measured by sales data.

requirements.Title: Grow CISS Profitable Share in New Segments
requirements.Description: Magellan must grow CISS profitable share by entering new segments.
requirements.Rationale: Expands business opportunities and increases profitability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: CISS share growth in new segments measured by sales and profit reports.

requirements.Title: Highly Leverage Watt-LE Mech Platform, Marconi-Hi Product (Reddington ID), and Solutions
requirements.Description: Magellan must highly leverage Watt-LE mechanical platform, Marconi-Hi product (Reddington ID), and solutions.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and risk, improves reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan leverages specified platforms and solutions successfully.

requirements.Title: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Magellan must integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks for improved ink delivery and reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures robust and efficient ink system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks integrated and functional in Magellan.

requirements.Title: New NGB Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Magellan must support new NGB keyed ink bottles.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability, reduces counterfeit risk, and supports high-yield requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan supports and operates with new NGB keyed ink bottles.

requirements.Title: Schedule (Least Flexible Constraint)
requirements.Description: Magellan must strictly adhere to schedule as the least flexible constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures timely market launch and aligns with business priorities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All milestones met as scheduled.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K (Least Flexible Constraint)
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA must have a life of at least 65,000 pages as a least flexible constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product reliability and meets warranty requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA achieves 65,000-page life in standard tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of Pages (2 Years)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support a warranty life of pages for 2 years.
requirements.Rationale: Meets customer expectations and reduces warranty claims.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Service Teams, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves warranty life of pages for 2 years in standard conditions.

requirements.Title: Throughput 25/20 PDL (Optimize Constraint)
requirements.Description: Magellan must achieve throughput of 25/20 pages per minute for PDL as an optimize constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Supports business and enterprise requirements for efficiency.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, End Users, SMB, Enterprise
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified throughput in standard tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability (Maintenance Box)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support serviceability with a maintenance box as an optimize constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Improves maintenance efficiency and reduces downtime.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer includes and supports maintenance box for serviceability.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution (Optimize Constraint)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support SMB solution as an optimize constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB market needs and improves manageability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan supports SMB solution features and manageability.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Schedule, Optimize Constraint)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) as a schedule, optimize constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Enables flexible business models and supports market segmentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan supports PaaS offering as scheduled.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK (Flexible Constraint)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support host 12K-CMYK as a flexible constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Allows adaptability for high-yield requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan supports host 12K-CMYK as specified.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K (Flexible Constraint)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support trade page 6K as a flexible constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Allows adaptability for trade segment requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan supports trade page 6K as specified.
